description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2022 World Championships, where the question everyone came with was how best to beat Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR. Arceus VSTAR does the attacking, Bibarel's Industrious Incisors and Trainer cards that search the deck keep it supplied, Flying Pikachu VMAX's Max Balloon shields it from Basic Pokémon's attacks for a turn, Path to the Peak switches off the Abilities of Pokémon with a Rule Box, and Boss's Orders brings any of the opponent's Benched Pokémon into the Active Spot. The 2022 World Championships were held at ExCeL London from 18 to 21 August 2022, the first in Europe and the first since 2019, after the COVID-19 pandemic put off the 2020 and 2021 events.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2022 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
